1.title: Can Trump’s Arch Be So Tall? A Panel Led by His Allies Tentatively Says Yes.
1.summary: The proposed 250-foot arch would violate a height limit on Washington structures under the traditional reading of the law. But a planning commission gave it preliminary approval anyway.

2.title: Inside the Implosion of Graham Platner’s Maine Senate Campaign: ‘A Slow-Rolling Disaster’
2.summary: Graham Platner’s bid for the Senate inspired progressive Democrats. But the campaign, which he suspended Wednesday, was messy, disorganized and ultimately doomed by a steady drip of scandal.

3.title: Tehran launches more strikes after second round of US attacks in southern Iran
3.summary: Centcom says it hit 90 Iranian targets in the latest round of strikes, with the Iranian health ministry saying 14 people were killed since Tuesday.

4.title: Live Updates: U.S. and Iran Sink Into Violent Cycle After Latest Strikes
4.summary: Attacks on ships were followed by new U.S. strikes on Iran, which responded by firing at Gulf nations. The pattern of hostilities has all but collapsed a cease-fire, with little sign that either side will step back.

5.title: Final Stage of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei’s Funeral Begins After Delay
5.summary: Thousands gathered for the procession in Mashhad for the supreme leader, who was killed in the first U.S.-Israeli attacks of the war. Hours earlier, the United States and Iran traded strikes.
